name: Partial Point Cloud Completion Optimization
definition: Optimizes an object latent code to best explain a partial point cloud, using ObjectNet as a prior to complete missing parts, followed by patch-level refinement to integrate details not captured by the object-level prior.
summary: Partial Point Cloud Completion Optimization reconstructs complete 3D shapes from partial inputs by decoupling coarse global completion from local detail recovery, enabling generalizable results without per-scene network training.
